==Description==
'''Bumper Kart''' was an unobtainable emote added when emotes were first added. Due to it not being released to the public, this emote was used by the developers.

'''Bumper Kart''' put the player in a red bumper cart, which can be used to ride around the map.

==Trivia==
*Although the '''Bumper Kart''' never became public, a very similar emote would eventually end up getting added years later, called the [[Bumper Cart]].
